scope: Standard two-player duel, original Alice/Arthur/Medusa/Sinbad, applicable official 2025 Excalibur erratum; optional teams, other sets, Adventures excluded. 2021 interpretation historical only.
method: Fresh source-only independent audit. Only manifest-enumerated inputs and own generated crops/renders/receipts read. No question bank, key, scope file, reader, grades, prior audits, canonical summary or other sources consulted. All original normative text read in contiguous original Unicode slices <=5000 characters, one slice per tool response. Raw HTML mechanically parsed in entirety; its complete visible result delivered/reviewed separately. All 120 cells visually inspected at native resolution, not inferred from representative duplicate cards.

checked_claims.checked: All physical components, health caps, fighters/hero/sidekick, deck counts agree.
Five-card opening, distinct decks, younger/older 1/2 spaces, same-zone sidekicks, each player initial decisions, younger first.

One fighter per space, connections, separated same-color zones, multizone, draw-before-move, zero/individual movement, friendly/opposing traversal, opponent perspective, one movement BOOST, dead-fighter cards usable for BOOST.
Two mandatory actions, repeat permitted, seven at end, ANY/active fighter/schemes, melee adjacency, ranged shared zone, simultaneous legal card choices, optional defense, versatile counts both.

Immediately/during/result/after card/after other/discard order; defender first, mandatory effects, attack-minus-defense zero floor, no return damage, attack-only winner test, sidekick death still allows effects unless duel ends.
Each missing draw 2 damage to all own fighters, no reshuffle, immediate hero end, remove defeated sidekick, health caps, own public face-up discard; multiple missing draws arithmetic checked.

checked_claims.sources: Sinbad character and all Sinbad action cells; designer article33170907
checked_claims.checked: Both fighters gain movement per discarded Voyage. All seven 2-value Voyages and distinct effects; only Home BOOST1, remaining six absent BOOST; 2019 designer explains intentional absence. Home returns other Voyages before normal self-discard.

checked_claims.sources: Feint cells + Arthur/Alice character + Noble Sacrifice/Momentous Shift + rulebook p12
checked_claims.checked: Defender Feint cancels attacker Feint first; Noble ability and printed extra BOOST canceled; BIG Alice 3+2=5, Feint2 gives 3 damage.

Voyage with 3 already discarded =2+3=5; Home alone after combat yields move2+1=3; Home discarded to maneuver BOOST adds both +1 terms; Jaws4 vs Skirmish4 gives zero attack damage, defender first can remove adjacency.
